== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English original and later English Errata articles for [[Clak'dor VII]]. Columns are Original and Decipher Errata (Glossary 2.0) only. Appendix A p. 107 matches that Glossary replacement, so [[Clak'dor VII (PC Errata)]] is a redirect to [[Clak'dor VII (Errata)]]. Locations use Light Side and Dark Side rows. The Glossary paragraph after the replacement (destiny modifiers on all Bith cards) is a ruling, not Card Text. Do not transclude onto Japanese, Revised, Two-Player, foil, or (V) articles. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per real Errata face; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
